description: Land Acquisition - Ampitigala, Madurawala D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land lots for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of properties, their locations, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
